brief:
New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has announced plans to disband a specialized police unit that was deployed to monitor pro-Palestinian demonstrations, according to Middle East Eye. The unit drew sustained criticism for employing aggressive tactics and generated high volumes of civilian complaints during its operations.

The decision follows months of pressure from advocacy groups and community organizations over the unit's conduct at protest sites across the city.
